glosses: An inhabitant of ancient Nubia or a person of Nubian descent.
An African or person of African descent.
A person with dark skin, as of Africans and people of African descent.
Synonym of Anglo-Nubian goat.
Pertaining to Nubia, its people or its language.
Pertaining to Africa, and its people or language.
Dark-skinned, as of Africans and people of African descent.
